text:
Marie (Support): Hey team, customer AcmeApp hitting sudden 502/504s on hosted /v1/embeddings during a burst around 15:06 UTC. Logs show upstream resets and a bunch of early closes :frowning:
Jamal (SRE): Seen it. Correlating traces -> envoy upstream 503/504 then 502 spikes. Trace id: trace-0a1b2c3d.
Aisha (Eng): Any config changes deployed to frontdoor or nginx at that time?
deploy-bot: deploy completed: frontdoor-proxy v2.4.9 at 15:00 UTC by andrea-deploy 
Marie (Support): Customer says they did a large embeddings batch request (single-shot, 120k tokens total across many parallel requests).
Jamal (SRE): Repro locally by sending parallel embed requests with keepalive reuse and large metadata. I can reproduce 502s when connpool saturates. Short notes: h2 stream reset + upstream GOAWAY from nginx.
Aisha (Eng): Sounds like connection window/keepalive exhaustion on midproxy. Can you paste the envoy upstream logs?
Jamal (SRE): paste logs: ```envoy upstream: stream reset by remote, error_code=NO_ERROR, details=upstream_connect_failure```
Ryan (Eng-Infra): Observed a spike in auth-cache latencies at same time (auth service 95p -> 800ms). A lot of retries piling on. Possibly auth rotation triggered heavier load and caused connections to back up.
Customer: AcmeApp: Our client uses short-lived tokens and rotates every 30s during the batch. Might be related.
Marie (Support): Ok combine factors: large parallel batches + token churn -> increased connection churn and backend auth latency -> frontdoor connpool exhaustion -> 502/504s.
Aisha (Eng): Quick mitigation: temporarily throttle concurrent embeddings for that tenant (rate limit) and increase per-upstream connection pool on frontdoor. Also bump keepalive timeout from 30s -> 60s to reduce churn.
Jamal (SRE): Implemented tenant throttle (50 rps) and bumped frontdoor upstream_max_connections by +200 in eu-west. Rolling now.
deploy-bot: config rollout started: frontdoor-upstream-pool-tune by ryan at 15:30 UTC
Marie (Support): Customer confirmed errors fall back to near-zero after throttling. They still see occasional 502s at tail end.
Jamal (SRE): Added short-term workaround: if upstream returns 502, fallback to a smaller model variant (lower concurrency) for 10s. Helps keep requests alive.
Aisha (Eng): Root cause summary for postmortem: parallel large-batch embeddings + token rotation causing auth-service latency -> upstream connection churn -> frontdoor/NGINX goaway/early-close -> 502/504s.
Ryan (Eng-Infra): Action items: #1 add circuit breaker to prevent auth latency from cascading into connpool exhaustion. #2 add tenant-level burst-limiter for embeddings. #3 improve telemetry: emit connwindow and h2 stream counts to trace timeline.
Marie (Support): Filing support ticket and notifying account team. AcmeApp wants a runbook for recommended client backoff and token rotation cadence.
Customer: AcmeApp: appreciate quick mitigation. We'll slow rotation to 2m and batch in smaller chunks.
Marie (Support): Follow-up: creating GH issue infra/4492 and PM doc for recommended embeddings client patterns. Marking this thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
Jamal (SRE): putting a short note in incidents channel with links to traces and config diff.
Ryan (Eng-Infra): I'll schedule a config hardening next week (increase pool defaults and add h2 drain smoothing).
Marie (Support): closing thread — will update when infra ticket is done.
